creatures.primary_habitat: Frozen Pine Barrens & Ash Dunes
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: One head sleeps while the other watches the horizon. Never attempt to sneak up on a pair of them in open snow. Fire flares at their feet; the two brains fight over which direction to run.

creatures.primary_habitat: Sub-surface clay strata and collapsed sewer culverts
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Size of a fat badger with overgrown shovel incisors. Totally blind, navigates by clicking its teeth against rock. Excellent stew meat if soaked in brine for twenty-four hours to pull the sulfur taste.

creatures.primary_habitat: Industrial foundry slag heaps and coal rail yards
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Feeds on pyritic ironstone and sulfur slag. Its elytra incorporate metallic iron crystals, deflecting 9mm pistol rounds with loud pings. Flip them with a pry bar and spear the soft pale belly.

creatures.primary_habitat: Ruined telephone wire grids and blast-scorched grain silos
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Unnervingly intelligent. They mimic human distress whistles to lure scouts near unstable masonry walls. If you shoot one, the flock remembers your coat color for three winters.

creatures.primary_habitat: Rooftops of the Abandoned Locomotive Depot
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Pads across rusted I-beams without dislodging a flake of rust. Drops from eight meters directly onto a scout's neck seals. Always travel through railway yards in pairs with bayonets fixed upward.

creatures.primary_habitat: Thermal discharge canals and flooded reactor cooling basins
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Weighs up to twenty kilos. Their silver scales shimmer with a blue Cerenkov sheen in dark water. Flesh requires boiling with vinegar and activated charcoal tablets to absorb dissolved strontium isotopes.

creatures.primary_habitat: Deep open-pit granite quarries and cracked cooling towers
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Two-meter wingspan with leathery armor folds. They roost inside cooling tower ribs. When disturbed, they emit high-frequency screeches that blow the audio circuits on geiger counters.

creatures.primary_habitat: Damp deadfall cedar trunks and bog hollows
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Grows to the size of a teacup when engorged with elk blood. Drops from overhanging branches onto rubber hazard hoods. Burn them off with a lit cigarette; crushing them sprays infectious blood.

creatures.primary_habitat: Irradiated beet root fields and frozen swamp borders
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Tough as a tank. Their bristles are matted with frozen mud and gravel, forming a natural composite armor plate. One charge will crush a scout's pelvis against a tree. Aim exclusively behind the shoulder.

creatures.primary_habitat: Flooded canal reeds and warm runoff culverts
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Lies submerged with only its glowing green caudal rattle visible above dark water, twitching like a water bug to attract frogs. Its hemotoxic bite dissolves human muscle tissue in six hours without antivenom.

creatures.primary_habitat: Stunted Willow Taiga & Radioactive Bogs
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Stands nine feet tall at the shoulder. The double palmate antlers can batter down log barricades. A single mature bull feeds our whole bunker canteen for a month. We track them by their steam plumes in -30°C cold.

creatures.primary_habitat: Abandoned drainage tunnels and railway cuts
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Spotted grey fur, sloped back, and jaw muscles powerful enough to splinter a steel shovel handle. They vocalize with human-sounding sobbing laughs to disorient sentries at night.

creatures.primary_habitat: Broken transmission towers and dead pine snags
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Feather barbs have velvety fringes for completely silent flight. Swoops down on snowshoe hares in total darkness. Sentry Stepan considers it good luck if an owl perches on the periscope mast.

creatures.primary_habitat: Flooded civil defense sump basins and stagnant cisterns
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Three-meter black muscular eel with a circular rasping mouth of concentric horn teeth. They lurk around underwater inlet grates. Never enter a flooded basement without probing with a long copper ground rod.

creatures.primary_habitat: Warm rubble brick piles and collapsed chimneys
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Blends seamlessly into grey brick rubble. Coils near hot chimney bricks on sunny winter afternoons. Dr. Vel pays two ration chits per live specimen to milk the neurotoxic venom for nerve-block anesthesia.

creatures.primary_habitat: Fast-flowing thawed creeks and dam spillways
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Incredibly playful and smart. Uses smooth river stones to crack open freshwater bivalves. Their thick pelts are 100% waterproof and command high trade value among the Canal Smugglers.

creatures.primary_habitat: Perimeter trenches, ruined suburbs, and town dumps
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Descendants of domestic guard dogs left behind in 1981. Hairless patches with mottled radiation lesions. Highly organized pack hunters. If you show fear or turn your back, the alpha launches the attack.

creatures.primary_habitat: Radioactive marshlands and sulfur drainage canals
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Six feet tall on needle-thin legs. Stabs fish and swimming snakes with a spear-like bill faster than the eye can track. Its sharp beak is prized by hunters as a lightweight dagger point.

creatures.primary_habitat: Deep limestone cavern complexes and abandoned military adits
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Twelve hundred kilos of bone and muscle. Blind eyes covered by milky scar tissue; senses vibrations through the cave floor from 500 meters away. Do not engage without heavy 7.62x54mm armor-piercing rounds.

creatures.primary_habitat: Deep fungal tunnels and rotting timber drifts
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Gentle, glowing silk moths the size of saucers. They harvest luminous spores from Blue Phosphor Moss. Dwellers collect their silk cocoons to weave fireproof filtration mesh and fine surgical thread.

creatures.primary_habitat: Hot geothermal steam fissures and brine pools
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Slow, peaceful reptile with an iron-hard carapace encrusted with golden sulfur crystals. When threatened, pulls into its shell and vents scalding steam from internal cloacal heat sacks.

creatures.primary_habitat: Snow-covered wheat stubble and willow brush
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Sporting two miniature sharp keratin prongs between the ears. Incredibly fast over deep powder snow. Trapping them with wire snares is the primary way we keep our children supplied with soft fur mittens.

creatures.primary_habitat: Sulfuric drainage adits and pyritic coal spoil heaps
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: Two-meter segmented crawler. When threatened, squirts concentrated formic-sulfuric acid up to four meters with pinpoint accuracy. Dissolves polycarbonate respirator visors in five seconds.

creatures.common_name: The Iron Monarch of Mount Karkov
creatures.primary_habitat: Windswept Crags of Mount Karkov Summit
creatures.harlan_scout_notes: The legendary phantom stag of the Tessarat Range. Stands twelve feet tall with antlers like a grove of silver birch. Does not fear gunshots; steps lightly across live minefields. The living soul of this mountain. If you spot him, do not raise your rifle—lower your head in reverence.
